author: Ankit
problem: A photo album holds per_page photos on each page. Return how many pages are needed to hold num_photos photos.
bug_description: Uses num_photos // per_page + 1, which adds an empty extra page whenever the photos exactly fill the pages.

comments.accurate: Number of album pages needed to hold all the photos
comments.wrong_behavior: Number of full pages plus one page for the remaining photos
comments.wrong_location: Page arithmetic checked; the empty-album case is the one to watch
